products.name: Omron HEM7156T Blood Pressure Monitor

products.description: Extra absorbency incontinence pads in standard length, with a rapid-absorption core and body-close fit. Supplied 24 per pack for residential and aged-care use.

products.name: Kleenex Aloe Vera & Vitamin E Facial Tissues 95 Pack

products.name: Manicare Nail Clippers with Nail File

products.name: Bodichek First Aid Kit 126 Piece
